read.thesis: Guidance cut to $7.8–8.0B adjusted EBITDA on diesel up 40% and weak residential, but management expects positive price-cost spread in 2027; no capacity additions discussed, while $8.5B Arcosa deal and $6B buyback add financial and M&A exposure.

capex.quote: we've invested $1.2 billion in growth CapEx

triggers.label: FY26 Adj EBITDA cut to $7.8–8.0B
triggers.quote: we are updating our financial guidance and now expect full-year Adjusted EBITDA to be between $7.8 billion and $8.0 billion

triggers.label: Aggregates price +6% mix-adjusted
triggers.quote: pricing was 5% ahead or +6% on a mix-adjusted basis

triggers.label: 2027 high single-digit pricing expected
triggers.quote: the expectation we have is for high single-digit pricing as we get into 2027

triggers.label: Residential subdued to mid-2028
triggers.quote: we don't really see any res recovery probably until mid-2028 at best

guidance.quote: we expect full-year Adjusted EBITDA to be between $7.8 billion and $8.0 billion
Net income between $3.1 billion and $3.3 billion
adjusted diluted earnings per share between $5.37 and $5.59
we expect Velocity to generate $400 million of annual Adjusted EBITDA run rate benefits by the end of 2028

guidance.value: $175M by year three; $60M in year one
guidance.quote: we currently expect approximately $175 million of run rate cost synergies to be achieved by year three
we are pleased to update our 2030 Adjusted EBITDA margin target to the upper end of our previously guided range at approximately 24%
Capital Expenditure Guidance -- $2.6 billion to $2.8 billion

red_flags.label: Net debt up to $15.0B; $8.5B Arcosa plus $6B buyback
red_flags.quote: Net Debt -- $15.0 billion at the end of the third quarter, up from $14.2 billion at the end of 2025.

red_flags.label: Diesel up 40% with cost recovery lag
red_flags.quote: we've seen a sharp increase with diesel up 40% in a short period of time
